brief_title: Effect of SGLT2 Inhibitor on Metabolic-Dysfunction-Associated Fatty Liver Disease in Patients With Insulin Resistance
official_title: Effect of SGLT2 Inhibitor on Metabolic-Dysfunction Associated Fatty Liver Disease in Patients With Insulin Resistance

arm_groups.label: Prediabetic patients will receive SGLT2 inhibitors
Diabetic patients will receive SGLT2 inhibitors.

brief_summary:
Metabolic-dysfunction-associated fatty liver disease (MAFLD) has evolved as a major health problem recently. Discovering ways to prevent or delay the progression of MAFLD has become a global focus. Lifestyle modifications remain the cornerstone of MAFLD treatment, even though various pharmaceutical interventions are currently under clinical trial. Among them, sodium-glucose co-transporter type-2 inhibitors (SGLT-2i) are emerging as promising agents.

In this study we aim to evaluate the effect of SGLT2 inhibitors on fatty liver disease in patients with prediabetes and type 2 diabetes

eligibility.criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Patients of both sexes aged≥ 18 years
* Obese and non-obese patients
* Patients with prediabetes or type 2 diabetes

Exclusion Criteria:

* Patients with liver disease other than NAFLD
* Patients with type 1 diabetes
* pregnant patients
* Patients with malignancy
